title: Parallel Courses
description:
# Parallel Courses

There are n courses labeled 1 through n. A relation [u, v] means course u must be completed before course v begins. Each semester, any number of courses may be taken if all prerequisites were completed in earlier semesters. Return the minimum semesters needed to complete every course, or -1 if prerequisites contain a cycle.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 3, relations = [[1,3],[2,3]]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: n = 3, relations = [[1,2],[2,3],[3,1]]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= n <= 5000
- 1 <= relations.length <= 5000
- Each relation has two course labels in [1, n], and its labels differ.
- All prerequisite pairs are unique.
